models.title: Performance-fee sharing leg
models.summary: Billed fee inside the sharing range as base fee plus sharing rate times active return above base.

relationship.original_equation: Billed fee = base fee + sharing x (active return - base fee), within [base, maximum]
relationship.locator: PDF: LM2 performance-based fee schedule Exhibit 8, printed p. 113 (PDF p. 121): base 0.25%, sharing 20% beyond base, breakeven active 1.50%, max fee 0.75%; billed fees 0.40%/0.50%/0.60% at active 1.00%/1.50%/2.00%; net 0.60%/1.00%/1.40%
relationship.translation_notes: Linear leg only (no min/max in the grammar); floor at base and cap at maximum are documented limits, not part of this expression. Decimals.

variables.definition: Sharing rate on active return beyond base, decimal
Active return for the period, decimal
Billed fee inside the sharing range, decimal

assumptions: Active return inside the sharing range (base <= active <= cap kink); single annual period.
limitations: Piecewise floor/cap excluded: below base the fee is the base (call floor); beyond 2.75% here the fee is the 0.75% maximum.

models.summary: Monthly net return as gross return minus the pro-rata monthly management-fee accrual.

relationship.locator: PDF: LM2 fee-structure effects Exhibit 10, printed p. 116 (PDF p. 124): gross avg 0.72%/SD 1.37%; month 1: MF0.5/PF0 1.96%, MF1.5/PF0 1.88%; month 2: MF0.5/PF0 2.96%
relationship.translation_notes: Monthly accrual of the annual management fee (division by 12 formalizes the PDF's end-of-month accrual). Decimals. Performance-fee columns follow different accounting (accrual balance) and are not this record.

variables.definition: Monthly return net of management-fee accrual, decimal

assumptions: End-of-month accrual of 1/12 of the annual fee; MF-only columns (no performance fee in the month).
limitations: First-order accrual (no intra-month compounding of the fee); management fee shifts the level without changing volatility (PDF note).
